title: Hollow Knight
description: Hollow Knight is a hand-drawn 2D action-adventure set in the fallen kingdom of Hallownest. Explore interconnected caverns, ancient cities, fungal wastes, and hidden passages while learning new abilities, fighting strange creatures, and uncovering a mysterious history. The Switch release includes the major free content packs.

gameplayPillars.title: Interconnected exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Hallownest is a large, layered world built around backtracking and newly unlocked abilities.

gameplayPillars.title: Precise combat
gameplayPillars.description: Simple controls hide a demanding combat system built around spacing, timing, and charm builds.

gameplayPillars.title: Boss mastery
gameplayPillars.description: A large boss roster rewards pattern recognition and patience.

gameplayPillars.title: Charm customization
gameplayPillars.description: Charms let players reshape combat, healing, mobility, and exploration strategies.

gameplayPillars.title: Free content packs
gameplayPillars.description: The Switch version includes major free content additions with extra bosses and challenges.
